scope: All36 original T09 supplemental criteria and36 transfers plus LSYS-EXEC-T09; original snapshots retained.

criteria.task: Write a bounded ELF64 little-endian inspection tool for original object/executable/shared artifacts, reporting header, section, program-header and symbol entries. Reject short headers, overflowing count-times-entry extents and unsupported classes without dereferencing file bytes as native structs.

ordinary_observation.claim: Checked borrowed byte parser reports actual headers/sections/programs/symbols without native-struct casts

transfer_observation.claim: Same parser handles actual ELF32/64 little/big-endian original vectors and rejects extended counts explicitly

criteria.task: For a synthetic PT_LOAD with offset0x1000, vaddr0x400000, filesz0x30, memsz0x50, derive mapped initialized and zero-fill ranges. Compare with a real original ELF and its section-to-segment mapping.

ordinary_observation.claim: Synthetic initialized0x30/zero0x20 ranges and filesz>memsz rejection

transfer_observation.claim: Original executable still runs with section table removed; program headers remain inspectable

criteria.task: Build one source as ET_REL, executable and shared object; inspect entry, undefined symbols, relocation tables and program headers. Classify each artifact before any execution attempt.

ordinary_observation.claim: Actual object/executable/shared classification uses header metadata, not suffix

transfer_observation.claim: Actual static PIE ET_DYN artifact inspected separately from shared-object role

criteria.task: Create separate local, global, weak, undefined and tentative-definition examples, using explicit GCC extension/flag labels for weak and common behavior. Explain nm/readelf output and default -fno-common separately from ISO C definitions.

ordinary_observation.claim: Actual local/global/weak/undefined/common symbols; no-common rejection and labeled common extension

transfer_observation.claim: Initialized external definitions conflict despite -fcommon

criteria.task: Construct main -> a -> b across two objects and an archive; maintain the unresolved/defined symbol sets after each input. Add a strong definition competing with a weak one and compare the chosen origin in the link map.

ordinary_observation.claim: Unresolved-set trace plus actual link maps identify a/b and strong-vs-weak origin

transfer_observation.claim: Strong definition remains unextracted when prior weak definition satisfied demand

criteria.task: Give two original TUs an accidental nonstatic helper named helper and retain the duplicate-definition diagnostic; repair ownership with internal linkage. Separately restrict shared-library dynamic exports and inspect the actual exported set.

ordinary_observation.claim: Duplicate helper diagnostic repaired with static ownership; exported set inspected separately

transfer_observation.claim: Single authoritative public helper executes through two clients

criteria.task: Create a three-member archive where only one member is initially needed. Inspect members and symbol index; map each exported symbol to a member and preserve the archive command and ordering.

ordinary_observation.claim: Three relocatable archive members and symbol index inspected

transfer_observation.claim: ar update retains omitted stale member; explicit delete removes it

criteria.task: Use main calling a(), archive A member a calling b(), and archive B member b returning42. Predict main,A,B and main,B,A before linking, then explain each unresolved-set transition.

ordinary_observation.claim: main,A,B executes42; reversed archive order fails specifically onb

transfer_observation.claim: Backward reference succeeds with repeated A and minimal group

criteria.task: Compare normal extraction, a minimal group and whole-archive for a registration-only member plus unrelated dead code. Explain exactly which member requires forcing and measure included sections.

ordinary_observation.claim: Normal/minimal group/targeted/whole extraction distinguish registration and unrelated bytes

transfer_observation.claim: Whole-archive introduces unused conflicting definition; targeted extraction remains valid

criteria.task: Compute the supplied S=4096,A=-4,P=4112 relocation and identify the corresponding symbolic/addend/place roles in one real original object. Distinguish an instruction-relative addend from the address of the next instruction.

ordinary_observation.claim: Actual S=4096,A=-4,P=4112 field encodes-20 alongside absolute4096

transfer_observation.claim: Actual i386 REL object retains in-field addend-4

criteria.task: For declared unsigned absolute32 and signed PC-relative32 models calculate boundary values, write independent little-endian encodings and compare one supported actual relocation of each kind.

ordinary_observation.claim: Actual absolute32 and PC32 bytes match independent encodings for two target regions

transfer_observation.claim: Moving only target changes displacement; no common-load-base assumption applies

criteria.task: For a signed8 synthetic relocation compare-20 and236, whose truncated low byte is identical. Reject out-of-range values before encoding and construct a real large-displacement link test only within an original nonexecuted layout.

ordinary_observation.claim: Synthetic signed8 bounds reject236 while accepting-20; actual out-of-range layout linker rejects

transfer_observation.claim: Signed/unsigned8/32 interval table derives bounds before encoding

criteria.task: Compile the same address-taking source as non-PIE, PIE and shared PIC with consistent compile/link options. Compare runtime-relocation obligations and loaded-address assumptions without treating ET_DYN as sufficient evidence.

ordinary_observation.claim: Actual EXEC, dynamic PIE and shared PIC artifacts separate role, metadata and addressing

transfer_observation.claim: Static PIE executes with no interpreter and an identified self-relocation symbol
limitations: Linux x86-64 GNU ABI/runtime experiments, not ISO C guarantees; timings include stated host noise.

criteria.task: Follow one local object address and one externally visible function reference through object disassembly, relocations, GOT/PLT entries and final linked code. Preserve symbolic correspondence across linker relaxation.

ordinary_observation.claim: Visible data/function paths inspected in object and final relocation/disassembly

transfer_observation.claim: Hidden target removes final PLT relocation under the stated binding contract
limitations: Linux x86-64 GNU ABI/runtime experiments, not ISO C guarantees; timings include stated host noise.

criteria.task: Count relocation records and writable pages affected for two equivalent original images, then separately measure startup under stated cache/environment conditions. Report record count, timing and causal uncertainty distinctly.

ordinary_observation.claim: Independent relocation/write-page inventory and22 paired launch samples measure distinct quantities

transfer_observation.claim: 22 samples separate lazy/eager load from first call; no monotone cost claim
limitations: Linux x86-64 GNU ABI/runtime experiments, not ISO C guarantees; timings include stated host noise.

criteria.task: Load a trusted original plugin by absolute path and then by a controlled local search path; record its recursive dependencies and selected interpreter. Deliberately supply a missing dependency without altering system loader configuration.

ordinary_observation.claim: Absolute and child-local search load resolve original recursive dependency; missing dependency rejected

transfer_observation.claim: Relocated original package executes with origin-relative dependency path
limitations: Linux x86-64 GNU ABI/runtime experiments, not ISO C guarantees; timings include stated host noise.

criteria.task: Provide two original implementations of a toy function returning11 or22 and compare an explicitly controlled interposition experiment. Inspect GOT/PLT and binding logs; no third-party process is targeted.

ordinary_observation.claim: Original11/22 interposition runs and binding trace identify selected provider

transfer_observation.claim: Hidden original symbol retains11 under the same preload environment
limitations: Linux x86-64 GNU ABI/runtime experiments, not ISO C guarantees; timings include stated host noise.

criteria.task: Create a plugin with a deliberately unresolved function used only on an uncalled branch. Compare RTLD_NOW and RTLD_LAZY in separate bounded child processes with a known-good plugin control.

ordinary_observation.claim: Lazy uncalled missing function loads; eager loading and lazy invocation reject in separate children

transfer_observation.claim: Missing data rejects at load in both modes with named symbol diagnostic
limitations: Linux x86-64 GNU ABI/runtime experiments, not ISO C guarantees; timings include stated host noise.

criteria.task: Extend the existing TLS test to record values and addresses for main and two threads before/after independent increments; inspect TLS sections and access sequences. Do not retain a pointer after its thread's lifetime.

ordinary_observation.claim: Main and two live threads have distinct TLS addresses and independent10-based increments

transfer_observation.claim: Plugin loaded after thread creation initializes separate40-based state in each live thread
limitations: Linux x86-64 GNU ABI/runtime experiments, not ISO C guarantees; timings include stated host noise.

criteria.task: Put two original initialization hooks in an ordered toy executable and record hook/body/finalization events. Identify sections and the runtime loop that invokes them; do not assume order beyond the explicit construction.

ordinary_observation.claim: GNU-priority hooks execute ABMyx with init/fini metadata inspected

transfer_observation.claim: Same hook metadata in custom entry produces only M without explicit walker
limitations: Linux x86-64 GNU ABI/runtime experiments, not ISO C guarantees; timings include stated host noise.

criteria.task: Draw producer/consumer/lifetime chains for TLS templates, init arrays and fini arrays using the supplied runtime source passages and actual metadata. Mark uninspected runtime bodies explicitly instead of filling gaps from function names.

ordinary_observation.claim: Source-bounded template→allocation→copy/zero→thread-lifetime and init/fini consumer analysis

transfer_observation.claim: Custom runtime selecting only init produces ABM; both consumers produce ABMyx with no runtime helpers
limitations: Linux x86-64 GNU ABI/runtime experiments, not ISO C guarantees; timings include stated host noise.

criteria.task: Define an original plugin ABI with a version/size header, one exported operation and hidden helpers. Reject a caller with an unsupported contract before interpreting later fields and inspect the dynamic symbol set.

ordinary_observation.claim: Original version/size operation validates bounded prefix before later fields; guard-page mutant exposes premature access

transfer_observation.claim: Old12-byte caller retains defaults;16-byte optional tail changes operation under checked flags
limitations: Original trusted DSOs only; guard-page fault demonstrates premature read, not code execution.

criteria.task: Export two named toy interface versions and test old/new consumer combinations, including one deliberately missing required version. Separate symbol-resolution failure from changed numeric behavior.

ordinary_observation.claim: Actual old/new GNU-versioned clients execute supported pairs and reject missing required version

transfer_observation.claim: Unchanged TOY_1 name with changed11→22 behavior fails semantic compatibility despite successful resolution
limitations: Original trusted DSOs only; guard-page fault demonstrates premature read, not code execution.

criteria.task: Change a public structure's layout and separately change an implementation behind an opaque handle. Classify source rebuild, old-binary linkage and semantic compatibility in a matrix; unsafe old-layout execution is excluded.

ordinary_observation.claim: Public layout rebuild changes actual offsets; unchanged opaque client executes against two private layouts

transfer_observation.claim: Same C return/release types with changed ownership violate release contract without invalid-free demonstration
limitations: Original trusted DSOs only; guard-page fault demonstrates premature read, not code execution.

criteria.task: Write an original linker script with FLASH[0x10000,0x10100) and RAM[0x20000,0x20080), explicit text/data/BSS sections and alignment. Reject an over-capacity object using ASSERT; do not execute the synthetic image.

ordinary_observation.claim: Declared FLASH/RAM layout accepted and over-capacity image rejected by RAM_BUDGET

transfer_observation.claim: 96-byte indivisible section fails64-byte bank; explicitly split48-byte sections use two banks
limitations: Synthetic addresses are never executed and do not establish a board memory map.

criteria.task: Place16 initialized data bytes at RAM VMA0x20000 with FLASH LMA0x10080, plus24 BSS bytes. Derive source/destination half-open intervals and verify the load image contains initialization bytes but not24 BSS payload bytes.

ordinary_observation.claim: Actual16-byte data LMA/VMA and24-byte BSS intervals independently checked against binary

transfer_observation.claim: 32-byte LMA padding changes copy table and raw extent while RAM intervals remain fixed
limitations: Synthetic addresses are never executed and do not establish a board memory map.

criteria.task: Export data_start,data_end,data_load symbols and document the chosen compiler/linker C declaration convention. Use symbol values to construct checked counts under that implementation contract, avoiding dereferencing a linker absolute symbol as stored data.

ordinary_observation.claim: Address-valued symbol declarations compile/link with checked uintptr_t subtraction under GNU convention

transfer_observation.claim: Actual emitted startup table validated transactionally against six invalid range/kind cases
limitations: Synthetic addresses are never executed and do not establish a board memory map.

criteria.task: Put an indirect registration entry in an archive member with no ordinary reference. Compare KEEP alone, explicit extraction and section GC, recording both member inclusion and retained sections.

ordinary_observation.claim: KEEP alone does not extract archive; explicit anchor and direct object preserve table under GC

transfer_observation.claim: Direct objects expose sections to KEEP; actual plain/LTO variants distinguish extraction
limitations: Synthetic addresses are never executed and do not establish a board memory map.

criteria.task: Build a table of two original callbacks reached only through registration, retain it deliberately and prove an unrelated unused function is eliminated. Check table boundaries and callback ownership.

ordinary_observation.claim: Two retained pointer callbacks execute11+22; unrelated function eliminated

transfer_observation.claim: Retained numeric table creates no callback relocation edge and numeric callback is collected
limitations: Synthetic addresses are never executed and do not establish a board memory map.

criteria.task: Diagnose a missing registration entry by tracing compiler emission, archive extraction, section GC and startup enumeration in order. Supply a deliberately broken case at each relevant stage.

ordinary_observation.claim: Independent absent emission/extraction/retention/enumeration cases identify first missing stage

transfer_observation.claim: Actual GCC LTO repeats registry experiment; slim object evidence differs from final symbols
limitations: Synthetic addresses are never executed and do not establish a board memory map.

criteria.task: Use real map files and ASSERT to accept32 BSS bytes and reject128 against a64-byte budget, then add alignment and a second section. Independently compute the expected region end.

ordinary_observation.claim: 32-byte BSS accepts and128 rejects64-byte budget; aligned17+16 ends at48

transfer_observation.claim: Reserved stack boundary and padding-overflow33+1 reject static collision
limitations: Synthetic addresses are never executed and do not establish a board memory map.

criteria.task: Create text, constant, initialized and zero-initialized objects, inspect actual section placement and account for retained versus optimized-away bytes. Separate ROM initialization bytes from RAM residency.

ordinary_observation.claim: Actual text/constants/data/BSS placement and40-byte runtime residency separated from16-byte initializers

transfer_observation.claim: Equivalent constant program under optimization/GC records actual retained section deltas
limitations: Synthetic addresses are never executed and do not establish a board memory map.

criteria.task: Compare ELF file size, raw load-image extent and runtime RAM for the same original layout, including headers/debug bytes and sparse gaps. State the metric before comparing configurations.

ordinary_observation.claim: ELF byte size,144-byte raw extent and40-byte RAM requirements reported as distinct metrics

transfer_observation.claim: Sparse Intel HEX preserves four addressed bytes without representing14 zero-gap bytes
limitations: Synthetic addresses are never executed and do not establish a board memory map.

criteria.task: Define original sparse bytes at0x1000:{01,02} and0x1010:{FE,FF}; derive raw output under explicit zero-gap fill and an address-bearing Intel HEX output. Decode both independently before any use.

ordinary_observation.claim: Original0x1000/0x1010 sparse bytes produce independently checked18-byte zero-filled raw image and HEX

transfer_observation.claim: Nonzero0xA5 gap fill preserves extent and changes materialized gap bytes
limitations: Synthetic addresses are never executed and do not establish a board memory map.

criteria.task: Produce a stripped original executable and separate debug companion, record hashes/build identity, and resolve one symbol/address through the matching companion. Deliberately pair a different build's debug file and reject it.

ordinary_observation.claim: Matching debug companion build ID/CRC resolves marker address; executable runs stripped

transfer_observation.claim: Different link base produces different ID/address; GDB rejects wrong companion CRC
limitations: Synthetic addresses are never executed and do not establish a board memory map.

criteria.task: Reserve one checksum byte in an original16-byte image. Define coverage as the other15 bytes, patch exactly once, and verify both prepatch and postpatch manifests with an independent sum-mod256 model; keep the debug ELF immutable.

ordinary_observation.claim: 16-byte original patches only excluded checksum byte and preserves pre/post hashes

transfer_observation.claim: Included-field zero-sum uses additive inverse; original debug ELF hash remains unchanged
limitations: Synthetic addresses are never executed and do not establish a board memory map.
